title: Shift-Invariant Cumulant Laws, Exact Stieltjes-Hankel Upper Certificates, and Minimax Resolution Limits for Continuum Spectral Edges from Imaginary-Time Evolution
abstract: Extracting the spectral gap Delta = E_th - E_0 and continuum threshold exponent alpha > 0 of an infinite-dimensional quantum Hamiltonian from imaginary-time evolution (ITE) was recently placed on a rigorous asymptotic footing by Karapetyan, Bondar, Marecek, and Wodecki (arXiv:2611.06454). At finite imaginary time tau, however, the logarithmic decay rate g(tau) = -d/dtau log F(tau) = Delta + alpha/tau + O(tau^-2) suffers an O(alpha/tau) systematic bias that confounds Delta with alpha, offers no assumption-free finite-tau certificate, and degrades only logarithmically as O(1/log(1/sigma)) under additive shot noise sigma. We resolve all three bottlenecks with exact cumulant identities, zero-dependency Lean 4 formalizations, and zero-floating-point-trust exact-Q moment certificates. First, we prove an exact covariance-boundary identity for the variance-corrected estimator Delta_VF(tau) = g(tau) - tau*kappa_2(tau): for any continuum density w(x) = x^(alpha-1) e^(-V(x)) on (0, B), Delta_VF(tau) - Delta = tau^-2 Cov_{U_tau}(U_tau, U_tau V'(U_tau/tau)) + B_B(tau) with a nonnegative upper-edge boundary term B_B(tau) when B < infinity, yielding non-asymptotic one-sided bounds at every finite tau > 0 via Chebyshev's association inequality (plus an exact modified-Bessel crossover law for the 1D van Hove band). Second, we introduce the shift-invariant cumulant estimators Delta_SI(tau) = g(tau) - 2*kappa_2(tau)^2/kappa_3(tau) and alpha_SI(tau) = 4*kappa_2(tau)^3/kappa_3(tau)^2: both are identically exact on the three-parameter Gamma-Exponential family x^(alpha-1) e^(-lambda x), and on general smooth continuum edges an exact O(tau^-2) cancellation between 2*kappa_2^2 and kappa_3 delivers two-order bias reduction—Delta_SI(tau) - Delta = c_2 alpha(alpha+1)/(tau+lambda)^3 + O(tau^-4) and alpha_SI(tau) - alpha = -3 c_2 alpha(alpha+1)/(tau+lambda)^2 + O(tau^-3)—where c_2 = (log phi)''(0) is the edge log-curvature. Third, we prove a spectral-edge trichotomy showing that tau^2 kappa_2(tau) uniquely classifies discrete excited states (-> 0 exponentially), power-law continua (-> alpha), and stretched-exponential pseudogaps (~ tau^(gamma/(gamma+1)) -> +infinity). Fourth, without any smoothness or monotonicity assumption, we derive interval-sound Stieltjes-Hankel upper certificates witnessed by rational vectors v in Q^(n+1) and verified strictly over Q (including exact unquantized rational logarithm upper bounds). Fifth, we establish poly-logarithmic additive-noise minimax resolution limits Omega((log(sqrt(K)/sigma))^-3) for Delta and Omega((log(sqrt(K)/sigma))^-2) for alpha in the asymptotic window via an explicit closed-form Le Cam two-point construction. All 16 core algebraic theorems are formalized in zero-dependency Lean 4 (v4.35.0, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice), and validated on 1D/3D one-center point interactions (267x-397x gap accuracy gain at tau=20), L=401 tight-binding impurity exact diagonalization (169x gain), 1D van Hove bands (7,630x gain), 6 exact-Q Hankel certificates (2.35x tighter than raw g(tau_max) with 200/200 noisy interval soundness), and additive shot-noise scaling.
keywords: Continuum spectral edges from imaginary-time evolution
